verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates without knowing the likely bracket site or how the family weights commute certainty, cost, and late-arrival dining. La Vista (B) is cheaper and minimizes the likely La Vista commute; Council Bluffs (C) is cheapest and optimal if that site is selected; Shadow Lake/Papillion (D) is the most site-flexible and better for a 10 p.m. arrival and early breakfast. Downtown (A) conflicts with the stated free-parking requirement and likely exceeds the effective budget once parking is included.
